assumptions: STILL OPEN: the derivation is a function of each member's DECLARED subject_quantity and asserts polarity, and those are authored. A member whose declared polarity is wrong derives a wrong verdict — EMB-BATTERY-CENSUS is that residue.
The mutation harness covers the four variants that were tried. Nothing enumerates the variants.
attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6 mutated EC-6 — AUTHORITY NON-AMPLIFICATION — from `not_decided_by_f` to `vacuous_pass` with a deliberately bogus explanation, ran scripts/emb-battery-control.mjs, and got exit 0 plus the printed assertion that an authority test `reads identically whether the externalization happened or never happened`. REPRODUCED HERE BEFORE ANYTHING WAS CHANGED, exit 0. The fourth appearance of this artifact's oldest family: R5.1 status inferred the obligation, R5.2 a stored reverse index could under-report, R6 an edge could be absent for free, R7.1 a stored classification nothing computes. The fix is that NO member stores a verdict — §3 derives all ten from the declared contrast, and §5 runs the exploit plus three variants against the real predicate on every invocation, with a positive control that the unmutated registry is NOT refused. MUT-EC6-INTERVENTION-SWAP is the one worth reading: moving EC-6's intervention to `support_ablation` derives `false_alarm` from its own `asserts: absence`, so even the smarter attack cannot manufacture an f-verdict.
